programmes.d: Carver Valleys comic festival is in full swing when the village is shocked by the murder of a former model.
When a local thief and womanizer is killed with a pitchfork, the residents of Midsomer Mallow fear for their chances in the Perfect Village Competition.
A death at the local Rugby Club sends Barnaby and Winter into a muddle of rucks.
Sleepy Goodman's Land is bought by a Texas oilman. After the sale, a string of grisly murders ensues.
Barnaby is less than impressed when Sarah drags him to a family friends wedding.
A new arrival to Challis Court, a tight-knit community for retired police officers, is found dead.
Things take a gruesome turn when Ferrabees Circus comes to town.
Midsomer Worthy's beloved local pub figures in a case involving unrequited love, secret business deals, and passionate affairs.
The appearance of a headless horseman at Quitewell Hall foreshadows a number of deaths amongst an aristocratic family.
Expert blackmailer Martin Barret is murdered and there is no shortage of suspects.
When a barrister is killed in Midsomer, suspicion falls on convicted murderer Grady Felton. Grady has just returned to the village where he committed the murder years ago amid much anger from locals.
The gruesome discovery of a farmer's eviscerated body in an ancient stone circle is made just days before the spring equinox.
The murder of a journalist has echoes of a 1960s horror film starring Midsomers own Stella Harris. When Stellas more famous sister returns after a 40-year family rift, the killings escalate.
Joyce talks Barnaby into enrolling in a spa located in a remodeled manor house but the bodies start to pile up when he's there.
As darkness covers Midsomer Stanton during a total eclipse of the sun, amateur astronomer Jeremy Harper is killed by a blow to the head with a meteorite.
When people start collapsing at the launch tasting of Midsomer Vineyard's newest sparkling wine, Kate Wilding discovers that the glasses had been laced with slug pellets.
Harriet Farmer wakes up after being in a coma since the night she tried to elope. Soon afterwards, a killer strikes members of a chess club.
Barnaby and Nelson join forces with two female Danish police detectives after a Midsomer businessman is poisoned during a trip to Copenhagen.
A woman is crushed to death with a giant round of cheese at the home of the world-famous Midsomer Blue. As other people linked to the dairy meet agonising deaths, long-held secrets start to emerge.
Something fishy is going on concerning the clubbing deaths of two local residents.
When Emily Simpson is found dead in her house, DCI Barnaby's instincts all lead him to suspect murder.
The Barnaby's plan to renew their wedding vows for their 25th anniversary when Tom is distracted by a murder committed with an Indian sword in Badger's Drift.
A writers' circle are about to witness a sequence of gruesome events far stranger than any fiction.
When Midsomer hosts its 12th Annual Literary Festival, an author is found with his neck broken. More writers will die before the winner of the competition is announced.

The peace of Ferne Basset is shattered when the body of quiet animal lover Agnes Gray is bludgeoned to death and found floating in the nearby river. The case is far from easy, when her cousin, Esslyn Carmichael, inadvertently cuts his own throat on stage during the final act of a production of Amade
Things take a gruesome turn when Ferabbees Circus comes to town bringing with it a chain of sinister clown sightings, threatening notes and deathly dangerous circus acts.

The villagers of Morton Fendle are up in arms when they discover the local craft centre, which they had invested in, is in financial uncertainty.
